headline: [Truce Tested!] Israeli Tanks Enter Central Gaza in [First Ground Push] Since Ceasefire
sub: Hamas calls it a ceasefire violation
caption:
⚠️ Truce Tested! Israeli Tanks Enter Central Gaza in First Ground Push Since Ceasefire

Israeli forces launched a ground operation in central Gaza on Wednesday, November 18, near Salah al-Din Street, east of Nuseirat refugee camp and north of Bureij camp. It is the first Israeli ground operation in Gaza since the ceasefire began in October 2025.

🔹 Hospital officials said three Palestinians were killed during the operation. Families fled the northern part of Nuseirat camp.
🔹 Israel's army said the aim was to "eliminate a threat" to its forces near the "Yellow Line", the boundary of the Israeli-controlled area set under the ceasefire.
🔹 Hamas called the operation a "flagrant violation of the ceasefire agreement" and said it holds Israel and the US responsible.

💬 Can the Gaza ceasefire still hold? 👇

Sources: Al Jazeera, NBC News
